O recibo é fornecido ao salvar um novo r: A receipt is provided when a new report is saved. Older reports without a code cannot be accessed through this form; public reports remain available on the map. There is no user ranking.
Guarde o recibo privado após enviar. Ele: Keep your private receipt after submitting. It lets you track and export your report even before publication.
Tire uma foto de um ponto seguro ou envi: Take a photo from a safe location or upload a JPG, PNG or WEBP image up to 12 MB.
Confira os objetos detectados, a quantid: Check the detected objects, count and confidence. AI can make mistakes.
Use GPS ou ajuste o ponto manualmente. C: Use GPS or adjust the point manually. Check the location and observed level.
AquaVerify avalia a qualidade documental: AquaVerify assesses evidence quality. Hashes and similarity checks help identify repeated images.
Autorize a publicação e envie. A equipe: Authorize publication and submit. The team reviews the report, location and possible duplicates.
Registros validados e autorizados aparec: Validated reports with publication consent appear on the map. Environmental condition and observation coverage are shown separately.
Consulte dias observados, níveis anterio: Check observation days, previous levels, photographs and the location page.
A recorrência, o tempo, o WPS e a qualid: Recurrence, time, WPS and evidence quality support an experimental persistence classification.
A equipe registra ações e acompanha nova: The team records actions and follows up with new observations. Compare before and after without assuming causation.

Informe um recibo por linha: ID; código: Enter one receipt per line: ID; private code. Codes only authorize access and are never included in exports. There are no user accounts or searches by author name.
As exportações desta página contêm ocorr: Exports contain photographic reports. Sessions without photos remain in Monitoring history. Other people's pending reports are never included in public exports.
Nulo = indisponível; zero = valor inform: Null means unavailable; zero is a reported or calculated value. CSV uses empty cells for null values and JSON text for lists. Text starting with formula characters is prefixed with an apostrophe in CSV/Excel.
São princípios orientadores, não uma cer: These are guiding principles, not FAIR certification. The team still needs to define the data and photo reuse license; public access is not an unrestricted license.
O JSON organiza Observation, Location, F: JSON groups Observation, Location, FeatureOfInterest, ObservedProperty and metadata. This internal profile is inspired by OGC SensorThings, without a server or compliance claim. phenomenonTime is null when capture time is unverified; resultTime contains the report timestamp.
As versões são gravadas nas novas ocorrê: Versions are saved with new reports. Missing versions in older data remain unavailable. Exported WPS and CS are snapshots saved on submission/review; dynamic map assessments can differ when history changes.

Como corrigir um registro?: How can I correct a report?
Como usar os dados?: How can I use the data?
O mapa publica somente registros validad: The map only publishes reports validated by the team with publication consent. Check the time period, layer and filters. Use your receipt in Track my report to check its progress.
O modelo procura padrões visuais de obje: The model looks for visual patterns of objects in a photo. Boxes represent detections, not unique objects across the area. Low confidence, similarity and other limitations require human review. See the methodology in Transparency.
Sim. As coordenadas confirmadas, a foto: Yes. Confirmed coordinates, the photo and location become public after consent and validation. Available accuracy is included in metadata. Do not submit your home location or photograph identifiable people without permission.
Não há edição direta pelo participante n: Participants cannot edit reports directly in this version. Keep the ID and use an official contact channel when available. The team must assess corrections; do not submit an identical photo to replace a report.
Abra Dados e Ciência Aberta, escolha a o: Open Data and open science, choose a source and apply filters. Read the dictionary and limitations before analysis. Public reports can be exported; your pending reports require a private receipt. The team still needs to define a reuse license.
Contribua com observações seguras, inclu: Contribute safe observations, including no visible waste, or join structured monitoring. Partnership proposals can be sent through official contact channels. There is no ranking by number of submissions.
Os canais de atendimento ainda estão sen: The team is still setting up contact channels. No message form is active on this page.
Ao pedir uma correção, informe o ID do r: To request a correction, provide the report ID and describe what needs checking. Do not post passwords or private receipt codes in public channels.
Você pode observar com segurança, partic: You can observe safely, participate in monitoring, contribute documentation or propose research and environmental education partnerships when contact channels are available.
Participação e cuidado seguro com o terr: Participation and safe care for the area. Symptoms and diagnoses are not collected.
Sinais declarados por quem observou, sem: Signs reported by the observer, without confirmation of cause, contamination or disease. Empty fields mean not provided. These signs do not affect the indices.
Confira as observações ambientais e o li: Check the environmental observations and the 500-character limit.
Somente observações ambientais. Não conc: Environmental observations only. Do not infer cause, contamination or diagnosis. Empty fields mean not provided; these fields do not affect WPS, CS or AquaVerify.
Observe com segurança: não entre na água: Observe safely: do not enter the water, touch waste or approach unstable banks. Do not risk your safety to take a photo.
Não identificado — equipe fará a vincula: Unidentified — the team will link it
O nome livre descreve o ponto. O agrupam: The free-text name describes the point. Grouping uses the water body code confirmed by the team.
